verdicts.reason: A: the oversized '20% off' runs almost to the right edge and sits on the cropped purple circle, which is now cut off from the product it framed; the product floats alone in a large empty lower area, the full-width CTA is cramped under the subhead, and the legal line is nearly as big as the subhead, which flattens the hierarchy. B: clean left-aligned stack (eyebrow, headline, subhead), the product is properly centred in its circle, and it reads headline, then product, then CTA. Its flaws are minor: the 'Ends Sunday' legal text is very small and low-contrast, and the CTA leaves dead space to its right.
